name: clinicpilot-e2e
description: Browser acceptance tests for the packaged ClinicPilot container

scripts.test:e2e:functional: playwright test --grep-invert "booking persists across an application restart"
scripts.test:e2e:persistence: playwright test --grep "booking persists across an application restart"
scripts.typecheck:e2e: tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck tests/e2e/workbench.spec.ts playwright.config.ts
